status: implemented; focused checks passed; final Root acceptance pending

transport.authentication: Existing browser cookie+CSRF or established desktop Bearer; no browser session mint for desktop. Preserve request/session/service/room scope; host/game mutations retain current revision fences; append-only chat follows the documented revision-independent rule.

reuse: existing C1/C2 live rules and rejoin review

hosting.create: Registered User+ may create; default AUTH1 generated name; Power+ custom name/higher capacity. roomCreate adds optional capacity:uint32 (1..32/current entitlement), password:string (max128). Host desktop creates then performs existing reviewed roomJoin; creating alone does not invent game consent or membership.
hosting.authority: Existing host account controls apply to browser and desktop; Admin/Dev do not acquire Start/config/End/delete/access powers by role.
hosting.delete: Existing inactive/no attached/prepared guard remains; desktop host allowed exactly as browser host.

roomPlayerDetails.permission: Non-game actor with visible lobby. Ordinary read-only. Exact target desktop must still be in that lobby. No private discovery bypass.

request.afterAccountId: optional UUID exclusive cursor, default empty

response.nextRoomBanAccountId: last returned accountId when more exist; empty when complete

roomBanList.ordering: account UUID ascending, bounded limit+1 read
roomBanList.permission: Host or current Admin/Dev with visible lobby; individual actions target-authorized

PlayerDetails.actions: string[] subset kick,ban,unban,mute,unmute; UI must consume current projection, re-fetch before confirmation/submission
PlayerDetails.inspection: Use existing inspectionList keyed by desktopId for actual seed/ordered mods; no remembered substitute.

moderation.request: Existing roomModerate:{accountId,action,desktopId?}; action adds mute/unmute. Include current expectedRevision/configRevision and desktopId from details for member actions.
constraints: Never target self or lobby host for any moderation action.
Host retains existing room authority over any other player regardless of account role.
Nonhost Admin may act only on User/Power User; nonhost Dev on any other nonhost. Ordinary/Power nonhost cannot moderate.
Kick/ban/mute/unmute target must currently belong to this exact lobby; supplied desktopId must still match account membership. Unban requires an existing room ban.
Recheck current enabled actor/target role and visibility transactionally; stale revisions/departed target fail without mutation.

Kick permits normal rejoin; ban denies rejoin until unban. Mute only denies new room-chat sends; read/game continues. It is per room/account, across browser/desktop/game-origin room chat; no global ban.
Accepted moderation audited atomically using session/request identity. Replays reuse existing durable command result; lost mutation replies must not issue a new identity.
moderation.retention: Mute persists per room/account across leave, kick and rejoin until explicitly unmuted; room deletion removes mutes. Existing successful chat retry is an idempotent receipt read after mute; new send denied CHAT_MUTED.

catalogue.source: Info.compatibility modes/capabilities/settingKeys plus current Config and canonical testing-starting-loadout.json. No unsupported Nemesis controls.
catalogue.seedDefaults: shared-random seed0 resolves once, randomizeLoot=true when capabilities support; existing fixed/individual rules unchanged.
catalogue.live: Existing C1 player rules and C2 world rules use separate CAS endpoints, independent of seed config.
catalogue.nextRun: Seed/loot/mode configure only current allowed waiting/ended/staging transitions; existing game protection/consent retained.

chat.deduplication: Accepted server sequence scoped room; stable requestId/existing receipts for mutation retries.
chat.revisionIndependence: Ordinary chatSend appends only to room chat sequence; stale configRevision/expectedRevision/run snapshot fields do not reject it. Current authenticated service/session and exact room, current host/account membership, bans/mute, content/byte/rate limits and immutable original request receipt remain required. Host/game commands retain their existing revision gates.

fixtures.composition: Existing apps/service/scripts/auth1-fixture-host.ts; no new controller. Root serializes actual Client composition.
fixtures.status: Generated DTO fixtures and real isolated service integration passed

joinLock.request: roomPolicy.joinLocked bool alongside current required capacity
joinLock.permission: Host non-game only in existing policy states. Existing members and host account may rejoin; new nonhost joins return LOBBY_LOCKED. No role-based bypass.
joinLock.semantics: Join lock is independent of capacity, password and visibility; it does not kick or mute anyone.

accessProjection.roomVisibility: Room.visibility visible to authorized lobby readers
accessProjection.hostAccess: Response.access:RoomAccess {visibility,admittedAccountIds} only for non-game host when Response.room is returned. Complete list max32, no truncation. Preserve omission when unavailable; never replace invitations from guessed defaults.

rejoinReports.permissions: Existing host list/review accepts established desktop or browser host; participants retain own status access. No local resume proof added.
rejoinReports.projection: Host list/status default remains compact to preserve the64KiB bound. Request status:{},participantId,observationReport:"original" returns Participant.originalReport?:GameObservation; observationReport:"pending" returns pendingReport?:GameObservation. Fetch each selected report separately for review. No response carries both full reports, and list never expands all observations. New starts capture immutable original orderedmods; missing old snapshot stays omitted.

websiteReadScope: Authenticated browser may read roster/inspection for a currently visible, non-banned lobby without a game membership. Room chat read AND send retain host/account membership eligibility. No private-name bypass. Viewing is not joining; desktop join remains explicit reviewed roomJoin.

uncertainOutcomes.receiptWindows: Custom room commands (including configure) use 30 seconds. Base chat uses 15 minutes. Foundation create receipts remain recoverable; do not infer create expiry from elapsed 30 seconds.
uncertainOutcomes.verifiedExpiry: Keep unknown outcome until explicit review/acknowledgment. Check button changes to Review expired outcome; reads current lobby/list and chat as applicable, presents current state with warning that history/list is incomplete and the original action may already have succeeded. Acknowledgment only releases the local pending guard; never sends a new request.
uncertainOutcomes.nextAction: User deliberately submits a new action after acknowledgment. Fresh form values/revisions adopted after lobby acknowledgment. Chat draft retained with duplicate-delivery warning. Auth/session/service/reference fences prevent stale acknowledgment.

mods.source: Legacy nt-app/src/views/Room.vue modList and vModUserTooltip.vue presentation, adapted to native DOM text rendering.
mods.identity: One current roster desktopId is one player; duplicate display names remain distinct. Only complete current scoped inspection inventory with no collectorFailure contributes; missing/incomplete/failed coverage is explicitly unknown.
mods.modIdentity: Exact activeMods string; Set deduplicates repeated entries per player. No normalization, invented names or external lookup.
mods.order: Count descending; name.toLowerCase ascending using lexical comparison; exact-name lexical tie-break for determinism.
mods.ui: Mods tab stays with existing per-player inspection and persistent chat. Count row expands via native button click/keyboard to current display names. Surviving rows retain expansion; lobby/session change clears contents and expansion.
mods.transport: Existing inspectionList and roster; no endpoint/schema change.

kickOnDeath.label: Kick on death
kickOnDeath.scope: Reporting account in the current run, including host and other selected desktops; winning remains exempt.
kickOnDeath.authority: Remove participation/current gameplay owners and same-run return eligibility; retain rooms.host_account_id and authenticated desktop/browser management. Existing same-run Join/lifecycle fences apply; End permits a distinct new run.
kickOnDeath.preserved: Current captured death mode, sender-excluded frozen recipients and original event/receipt dedup. No change to weak penalty magnitude, full respawn, end or win meaning.

sharedDeathEnd.transport: Existing desktop /v3/lifecycle/rpc WorldState terminal reason; no schema change. Protected client metadata consumes this reason for a scoped idempotent FinishRun/GameOver, not another death publish or penalty.
sharedDeathEnd.trigger: Accepted non-win death under captured NT_death_penalty=end, or terminal death/life completion under captured weak_respawn. Current later rule edits do not override original event.
sharedDeathEnd.transaction: Freeze original event/rules/recipients; persist actionable world reason for exact-run participants before canonical cancellation/revocation. Reuse RejoinRooms.cancel ended and gameplay synchronization/bank wake. Ownership and current non-game sessions retained.
sharedDeathEnd.recovery: Paused/disconnected owners read reason under current desktop auth; no game credential required. Offline reconciliation cannot erase this reason. Old world retains old association/reason even after distinct new run.
sharedDeathEnd.freshRun: No automatic creation/replay. Deliberate Join/preparation/current inspections and explicit Start are required for a distinct run/world.
sharedDeathEnd.preserved: Winning never triggers shared death end. Full respawn and ordinary weak respawn retain captured behavior. No extra 20% terminal-death cascade.

presentation.transport: Same-origin static /packages/contracts/src/lobby-setting-hints.js, no RPC/schema/default/permission change. Client consumes this canonical asset through its UI packaging.
presentation.labels: Canonical safe label/help text; help opens only from dedicated ? hover or keyboard focus. No row/input titles, inline tooltip prose or layout reservation; one visible tooltip at a time.
presentation.groups: One Save settings and one Reload settings across all groups. Full supported-draft validation before writes; changed groups only, deterministic C1 -> C2 -> admission -> access -> world/transfers order. Preflight source-group comparisons permit current revision use only when reviewed group values remain unchanged. Confirmed group baselines advance; remaining drafts retained. Multiple APIs are not atomic.
presentation.create: Signed-in Create lobby beside Refresh opens existing form in accessible modal. Escape/Close/Cancel preserve same-context draft and pending original request without submission/replay. Validation/server errors keep modal/draft. Success enters lobby/closes modal; auth/service turnover clears context draft.
presentation.seed: Generate new random seed uses browser crypto to fill a visible nonzero uint32, selects shared-fixed in draft, no network until Create/Save. Ordinary shared-random policy still resolves normally.
presentation.guards: World/Transfers held for active/generated world using existing projected state, with service remaining authoritative. Live rule controls remain independent.
presentation.uncertainty: Stop the batch on any refusal or unknown outcome. Keep immutable scoped original request identity. Explicit Check original reconciles only that operation; never resumes the batch. C1/C2 CAS writes whose unknown original can no longer be confirmed require explicit read/acknowledgment; retained drafts remain separate deliberate new intents. Reload reads all groups before replacing fields and never clears pending originals.
